# Pull Request

## Change

Describe the problem and the proposed change. Link the issue when applicable.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused regression tests.
- [ ] Ran `pwsh -File scripts/verify.ps1` (or explained why it could not run).
- [ ] Updated documentation and changelog for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Reviewed API and semantic compatibility, dependency licenses, and sensitive data.

## Compatibility

Describe any changed outputs, public API changes, or migration steps. Write "none" when applicable.
